steps.title: Как описывать изменения
steps.html:
В описании изменений нужны три вещи: что было, что стало, и одна цифра, показывающая масштаб.

It used to be…, but now… — базовая конструкция. Compared with… и There has been a big increase in… делают то же формальнее.

On the other hand разворачивает описание. Текст, где всё только улучшилось, — не отчёт, а реклама.

Пассив из прошлого урока здесь много работает: The warehouses have been renovated.

steps.title: The old port district: then and now
steps.html:
Читайте как автор: заметьте, где стоят цифры и где отчёт разворачивается.

Образец

This report describes how the port district has changed over the past decade and makes two recommendations for visitors.

Then. Ten years ago the area was run-down and largely empty. The warehouses had been closed since the port moved north, most of the buildings were unused, and the only reason to go there was the fish market on a Saturday morning. There was one café. It shut at four.

Now. The warehouses have been renovated and the district has become one of the city's main attractions. Two of them are now boutique hotels; a third is a state-of-the-art gallery. There has been a big increase in the number of places to eat — from one café to more than forty restaurants and bars — and the old market building is open six days a week. Compared with ten years ago, the area is unrecognizable in the evening, when it is dominated by people who do not live there.

On the other hand, the change has not been welcomed by everyone. Rents have risen dramatically, and many of the families who lived above the warehouses have moved inland. What used to be a working district is now, in the words of one resident, a place people visit.

Recommendations. If you have half a day, I'd recommend the gallery, which is free before noon and rarely crowded. And it's well worth going to the market early on a Saturday: it is the one part of the district that has not changed at all.

steps.title: Теперь напишите свой отчёт об изменениях.
steps.sub: Примерно 150–200 слов, пять коротких разделов, как в образце. Возьмите место, знакомое вам годами.
steps.html:
1. 1 · Одна строка о том, чему посвящён отчёт.
  2. 2 · Тогда: каким место было. Прошедшие времена.
  3. 3 · Сейчас: каким стало, минимум с одной цифрой.
  4. 4 · С другой стороны: что было потеряно и кем.
  5. 5 · Две рекомендации, каждая с причиной.
This report describes…It used to be…, but now…There has been a big increase in…Compared with…On the other hand…I'd recommend…It's well worth …ing
